opening.argument: The offer requires a $99 Bitcoin Cash payment and a mining-pool share purchase starting at $500. It links participation to recruiting others, describes percentage-based commissions or repurchase terms, and presents tiered purchases, possible share doubling, compounding, and a GPU-pool “Earn 100%” claim. It also describes mining shares operating for stated periods and mined Bitcoin being reinvested into partial shares. Those payment and return mechanisms establish a paid mining or node-return solicitation, although actual payments, mining performance, or delivered returns are not established.
